answer: A bot can print a name in a second; it cannot print a decade. Credit history with bureau attestation is the decade: a credit file spanning years and held by the national bureau. The ocean of the check is the paper trail — every entry stamped by someone else, at a time nobody here controlled. The dawn in the trail is the money spent over the years: fees, premiums, charges. The falcon that closes the gate is one question put to the office that stamped it.
